d: Keeta is an independent brand of Meituan, the world's largest tech-driven retail company. We focus on food and consumer product delivery services in international markets with the mission: "We help people eat better, live better". Keeta launched in Hong Kong in 2023 and has already achieved full regional coverage. We are now expanding into the Saudi market, with plans for further global expansion.

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the first point of contact for our customers. You will assist them with their orders, resolve any issues that arise during the delivery process, and ensure a positive and memorable experience with every interaction. This role requires excellent communication skills, a patient demeanor, and a deep understanding of our products and delivery logistics.
r: Handle customer inquiries and complaints via phone, chat, email or any other channel that Keeta deems fit for providing support to our customers (Customers/Riders/Merchants).
Provide detailed information about our products and services.
Assist customers with order placement, modifications, and cancellations.
Track and monitor delivery statuses, and coordinate with logistics, Sales, Tech/Product or any relevant Keeta departments to ensure timely deliveries.
Resolve any issues related to delivery, payment, or service dissatisfaction.
Maintain a high level of professionalism and brand alignment in all interactions.
Collect and report customer feedback to the management team to improve service quality.
Participate in training sessions to stay updated on product or policy changes.
Willingness to work in shifts that could be scheduled during a 24 hour window.
Bachelor's degree required; recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
0-1 years of experience; fresh graduates with no prior experience are welcome.
Fluent in both Arabic and English, with excellent communication skills.
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused attitude.
At Keeta, we foster an innovative and collaborative environment that values creativity and teamwork. We embrace a rich diversity of cultures and perspectives, empowering you to make an impact.

d: Positive Zero is powering the region’s energy transition by helping businesses, communities, and cities take control of their energy future—without the upfront cost or complexity.
With over 500 MW of decentralised power in operation and $31M in client savings to date, we’re a leading energy transition partner across the GCC for the commercial, industrial, and public sectors.
Our decarbonisation-as-a-service model integrates solar, on-site utilities, energy efficiency, fleet electrification, and clean energy on demand—reducing costs, consumption, and carbon footprint.
We manage everything end-to-end, with a 200-strong team across Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Oman, and Bahrain delivering scalable, long-term solutions.

We are looking for an experienced Legal Counsel to join our growing team. This is a hands-on, business-facing role providing pragmatic legal support across commercial, project, and corporate matters. The role is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, partnering closely with stakeholders across the business, and taking ownership of legal matters from start to finish while helping support the company's continued growth.
q: Commonwealth-qualified lawyer (UK, Australia, New Zealand, Canada)
Training and/or post-qualification experience with a leading international law firm
Strong background in commercial contracting and corporate law
Experience in energy, infrastructure, industrial, or construction sectors is highly advantageous
Comfortable operating autonomously within a lean team
*Only relevant applicants will be contacted at this time.
r: Draft, review, and negotiate a range of commercial agreements (EPC, O&M, supply, services, NDAs, partnerships)
Support project development, transactions, and financing documentation
Advise on corporate structuring and governance matters
Provide practical, day-to-day legal guidance to internal stakeholders
Identify and mitigate legal and regulatory risks

d: Welcome to the future of nuclear energy, where Westinghouse Electric Company is leading the field with expertise and progress to shape the power of tomorrow.
At Westinghouse, innovation is in our DNA. We are creative. We think differently. We reimagine the possible across the nuclear industry every day.
As a Senior Project Manager you will be responsible for project management processes, leading teams (average <10 team members), which may include project controls.
You will report to the EMEA, Project Execution Lead and be located at Barakah NPP.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business, Construction Management, Manufacturing or related technical discipline.
8 + years of experience as project manager in a technical industry such as engineering, manufacturing, nuclear or construction.
Work experience in Power generation or Nuclear sector valuable.
Knowledge of Industrial Automation and I&C valuable.
Complete project manager qualification within designated time period, exemptions provided based on prior training and work experience.
Project controls-related certification (scheduling, estimating, earned value, risk...) valuable.
Availability to work in Barakah NPP.

We know that to put forth your best effort, you need to be challenged and enjoy what you do in a supportive and respectful environment. We aim to maintain this balance by offering our employees the amenities, benefits and training they need to reach personal and professional goals.

r: Develop relationships with team, customer, suppliers, Westinghouse in-country representation (for international projects), and other partners to bring project to successful completion.

Complete all aspects of initiating and planning processes including authoring charters and project management plans which include developing scope, schedule, and cost baselines as well as, risk and partner registers.
Manage all aspects of project including scope, schedule, cost, risk, procurement, quality, resources, communications, and partners.
Coordinate project communications ensuring team, customer, and all partners are kept informed of status.
Identify opportunities for additional business growth.
Perform final project quality assessment and report out.
Evaluate opportunities for implementation of efficiency and cost improvement efforts such as simplification, process improvement and driving unnecessary cost out of processes.
Demonstrate and share knowledge of use of industry standard tools and practices such as Human Performance, Nuclear Safety Culture, CAPAL Corrective Actions Program and Learning Clocks.
Understand and promote the safety culture in the company by placing safety as a top priority.
Understand and apply the Westinghouse quality procedures and ensure compliance with company Quality Management System.
